words.definition: A round fruit that can be red, green, or yellow, and grows on trees.
A two-wheeled vehicle you pedal with your feet to move forward.
A type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, before humans existed.
A machine that can be programmed to do tasks, sometimes looking or acting like a person.
An arc of colors that appears in the sky when sunlight shines through rain.
A vehicle that uses powerful engines to travel into space.
A large building with thick walls and towers, built long ago to protect the people inside.
A mythical creature often shown as a huge, fire-breathing, winged reptile.
A person in stories who can perform magic spells.
A musical instrument with strings that you pluck or strum.
A tool used for writing or drawing, usually with a wooden case around a graphite core.
A flying insect with large, colorful wings that starts life as a caterpillar.
Valuable things like gold, jewels, or coins, often hidden or hard to find.
Food made by putting fillings like meat or cheese between two slices of bread.
A folding device you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain.
A bag with straps that you carry on your back to hold your things.
A figure made of packed snow, usually shaped to look like a person.
An outdoor fire built for warmth, cooking, or light, often while camping.
A tower with a bright light at the top, built to guide ships safely along the coast.
A place where a stream or river flows over a steep drop, falling straight down.
A tough piece of fabric stretched over a frame with springs, used for jumping and bouncing.
A short board on four wheels that you stand on and ride.
A snack food made from corn kernels that puff up into fluffy pieces when heated.
A rubber bag that stretches when filled with air or gas, often used for parties.
